entities.summary: Torsten Stålhandske was a professional soldier from Porvoo in Finland, who served in the Swedish army during the Thirty Years' War. An able cavalry commander and leader of Finnish Hakkapeliitta troops, he was promoted to general in 1643.

entities.summary: Torsten Stålhandske was a professional soldier from Porvoo in Finland, who served in the Swedish army during the Thirty Years' War. An able cavalry commander and leader of Finnish Hakkapeliitta troops, he was promoted to general in 1643.
